Good questions

Let’s keep
things clear.

Something else on your mind?
Ask us before you commit.

Why pay when free website builders are available?

Free builders can be a good choice if you want to create the website yourself. Our fee covers the agreed work: organising your services and content, making your business look consistent, setting up contact options and testing the customer journey. You have one person to guide the setup and handover, with optional help afterwards. A website alone does not create demand; it gives customers a clear place to check your business and contact you.

What does a one-page website include?

One scrolling page with sections for your business introduction, services, service area, photos and contact details. Visitors can jump between sections using the menu. It is a simple option when your business can be explained clearly on one page.

Is this only for tradies?

No. We also help cleaners, gardeners, tutors, beauty providers and other small service businesses. We shape the pages and contact options around what you do. A link to an existing booking service is straightforward; new booking systems, online payments, shops and memberships need a separate quote.

Do I need to write all the content?

For Get Online, you provide your basic text and we tidy it up. Business Ready includes a short interview and help writing the included pages from the business facts you supply.

Can I add photos of my work myself?

Self-service photo editing can be quoted as an optional extra. We confirm the platform, demonstrate it and explain its setup and subscription costs first. You can also send us photos to update within your care allowance or as separately quoted work. The photo demo shows the idea; it is not a live client account.

What costs continue after launch?

Your domain, hosting, email and any editing platform have their own subscriptions. These will be itemised before you commit and paid directly by you. Our optional care and marketing plans are separate, and any advertising budget is agreed upfront.

Who owns my website and accounts?

You retain your domain and business accounts, and receive the access and handover details. Your agreement will explain website ownership and any platform limits, including what can be transferred if you move providers.

Will a website bring me more enquiries?

A clear website can help people understand your services, assess your work and contact you. Enquiry numbers also depend on how people find you, local demand, your offer and how you respond. We do not guarantee leads, rankings or revenue. Search, advertising and content support can be scoped separately.

Do you sell leads or charge for each enquiry?

No. Eastside Connect builds your business website and offers optional marketing support through Sonimi Studio. Requests through your website go to your business; we do not resell them to other providers. Your customer may still seek other quotes. You pay the agreed service fees and supplier costs, not a fee per enquiry.

Do I have to pay for ongoing support?

No. Ongoing plans are optional. Website Care can be cancelled before the next billing month; the duration and notice for a marketing plan are agreed in your quote. You can also request a separate quote for occasional changes. Any editing platform you choose may have its own subscription.

Can you help with marketing after launch?

Yes. Our Marketing & Support retainer can combine social media, content production, Google Ads, Meta Ads, local SEO and website care. Your quote lists the selected services, post quantities, campaign scope, approval rounds and reporting. The $69 Website Care plan covers website support only. Advertising budgets and paid tools are additional, and we do not guarantee rankings, leads or revenue.

Can you help if I already have a website?

Yes. We first check your website, access and existing setup. We then quote any initial work and an appropriate ongoing plan. A rebuild is only proposed when there is a clear reason for it.

Who handles messages and customer enquiries?

You remain responsible for sales enquiries, bookings and customer replies. Social inbox monitoring and comment moderation are only included if specifically agreed in your plan.

How soon can my website be ready?

We agree on timing after checking your scope and content. Having your photos, business details and feedback ready helps. Google verification and any account recovery may follow a separate timeline.
